abstract: Maintains neighborhood grievance logs and resident informational outreach scores
system_message:
You are Community and public affairs officer (COMM). The Community and public affairs officer (COMM) maintains neighborhood grievance logs and tracks resident informational outreach scores across metropolitan rail transit rehabilitation projects.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Neighborhood notification outreach（SURV）
information_points.content:
COMM-SURV-W4N：For properties situated within 200 meters of tunnel ventilation shafts, the Continuous mechanical excavation and concrete lining plan achieved a direct residential flyer delivery coverage of 95%.
COMM-SURV-PFY：The Modular prefabricated invert slab replacement plan attained a direct residential flyer delivery coverage of 75% among targeted addresses within 200 meters of tunnel ventilation shafts.
COMM-SURV-RV0：Outreach dispatch records for the Segmental hydrodemolition and shotcrete restoration plan show a direct residential flyer delivery coverage of 85% across properties within 200 meters of the ventilation shafts.

information_points.title: Maintains neighborhood grievance logs and resident informational outreach scores（PUBL）
information_points.content:
COMM-PUBL-JGQ：For the Segmental hydrodemolition and shotcrete restoration plan, the public stakeholder sentiment score evaluated across transit rider advisory committee members stands at 55 points.
COMM-PUBL-37K：According to the transit rider advisory committee survey on staging logistics, the Continuous mechanical excavation and concrete lining plan received a public stakeholder sentiment score of 72 points.
COMM-PUBL-KG0：Evaluation records from the transit rider advisory committee indicate that the Modular prefabricated invert slab replacement plan achieved a public stakeholder sentiment score of 88 points.
